title: Use a RAM-only YubiKey-gated rescue ISO
rationale: The same reusable ISO must provision hosts that may initially be reachable only through Tailscale; GPG/YubiKey/SOPS gates access while state=mem prevents rescue identity persistence.

name: Derive Tailscale hostname at runtime
description: Use a short hashed suffix derived from DMI UUID, machine-id, or MAC fallback for rescue-<suffix>; never bake a per-host Tailscale hostname into shared media.
